The '''Joben-Dusat Racing Team''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] racing team founded by [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]]. Working from their [[Ingo speeder shop|speeder shop]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]], Joben and Dusat built the ''[[White Witch]]'', a heavily modified [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[C/L-82 landspeeder|C/L-82]] which Joben [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] to victory in the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].
